electrical.dc_note: Thresholds are stated against IOVREF, a separate 1.8 V reference rail, not as a fraction of the pad's own VDDIO. On a 3.3 V G12/SM1 pad that puts Vih min near 2.17 V rather than the 2.31 V a 0.7×VDDIO rule would predict. Every VDDIO domain is LV/HV selectable, so which column applies depends on what the board feeds that rail.
